name: Foundation in Regulatory Sciences Minor
intro: The Foundation in Regulatory Sciences minor will deepen students’ understanding of current regulations and quality practices with practical application in the development and commercialization of drugs, biologics and medical device products. This minor will broaden perspectives and integrate knowledge to allow students to effectively understand the regulatory process.
